stumbles.quote: Colour matches a reference to mean ΔE76 0.07.
stumbles.why: The text never says what the reference is (a photo, a physical film, a thin-film optics formula). Without that, the number tells me nothing.

stumbles.quote: so thick film sinks toward the tilt and thin film rises
stumbles.why: "Toward the tilt" is unclear. I can't tell whether it means downhill, or toward a tilted edge, or what is being tilted.

stumbles.quote: It drains at the border, goes black from the top and pops.
stumbles.why: "It" has no clear referent, and "goes black" is unexplained. Readers who don't know soap-film optics won't know that black means the film is very thin and about to burst.

point: The author built a WebGPU compute simulation of a soap film that drains, thins, turns black and pops. They say its colours closely match a reference, but it hasn't been tested on a phone yet.
